accommodation: Holiday lodges with private balconies, some with hot tubs; designated pet-friendly units. Holiday homes also sold for ownership. Number of units not stated.
suitableFor: Families, couples, golfers, dog owners (designated pet units only)
parking: One parking bay per holiday home; extra vehicles must use public car parks; no parking on grass.
dogs: Only in designated pet units; dogs on a lead on park and golf course; welcome in The Boathouse.
beachAccess: Site says Praa Sands beach is 'right on our doorstep'; no distance given.
confirmedFeatures: Heated indoor pool, spa pool, gym, 9-hole golf course, The Boathouse bar and restaurant with sea-view terrace, children's play area, takeaway, launderette, free Wi-Fi in lodges, accessible toilet
overview: A lodge-based holiday park run by Haulfryn above Praa Sands, the long sandy beach between Penzance and Helston. Alongside the lodges it has an indoor pool, gym, a nine-hole golf course with views over Mount's Bay and The Boathouse bar and restaurant.
surfTripFit: The park sits beside Praa Sands, one of the more reliable beach breaks on the south Cornish coast, so it suits surfers wanting facilities for non-surfing family members. No board storage or outdoor showers are mentioned.
